fnol_text: My name is Aisha Kaminski and I live at 208 Kestrel Road, Fairview, PA 16412. You can reach me on (555) 793-1711 or aisha.kaminski@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 30 October 2026, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2024-00107. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. Am I insured for this or not?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Kaminski on (555) 793-1711 to acknowledge the claim. Aisha confirmed the loss date as 30 October 2026.
Site visit to 208 Kestrel Road. Neighbour Zara Wojcik was present and confirmed the timeline.
Aisha sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
